tests.name: edit, durable save, reload and actual MIDI download
quota failure keeps edits, exports JSON and retries the latest version
startup read failure exits loading and retries without deleting the stored song
update reload is blocked on save failure and preserves the last edit after retry
failed lazy JS shows recovery and saved reload restores the workspace
worker cancellation keeps the existing song
editing while a worker runs discards its obsolete result
real module Worker preserves full arrangements, diagnostic, scoped recipes and restored versions
a visible page detects a published update without switching tabs
real worker generation applies a new version and leaves the UI thread responsive
an AI proposal cannot be applied before its worker result is ready
